compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I want Phase F Step 18, Phase G Step 2, and the d039-ac65 re-dispatch site to call dso:verification-remediation-planner BEFORE any remediation ticket is written
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Modify /dso:sprint at three dispatch sites (story-level Phase F Step 18, epic-level Phase G Step 2, d039-ac65 re-dispatch) so that on P1 != PASS the orchestrator: (1) dispatches dso:verification-remediation-planner before any remediation ticket is created (including draft, placeholder, or precursor tickets); (2) dispatches the indicated decomposer with decomposer_context when confidence != LOW; (3) emits HALT_FOR_USER surfacing planner evidence when confidence == LOW.

**Why**: SC3 caller-side — closes the loop between verifier non-PASS and the planner agent. The "no ticket creation between verifier-result and planner-result" invariant is load-bearing for producer-fidelity.

**Scope**:
- IN: /dso:sprint Phase F Step 18 edits, Phase G Step 2 edits, d039-ac65 re-dispatch site edits
- IN: Sprint end-to-end fixture covering all 4 decision-tree branches
- IN: Per-site assertion that no ticket-CLI call occurs between verifier-result read and planner-result read
- OUT: Planner agent itself (delivered by SC3 planner-agent story — depended on)
- OUT: Shared loop protocol (delivered by SC4 shared-protocol story — depended on)

## Done Definitions

- When dso:completion-verifier returns P1 != PASS at Phase F Step 18, the orchestrator's next dispatch targets dso:verification-remediation-planner BEFORE any remediation ticket creation
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When dso:completion-verifier returns P1 != PASS at Phase G Step 2, the orchestrator's next dispatch targets dso:verification-remediation-planner BEFORE any remediation ticket creation
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When dso:completion-verifier returns P1 != PASS at the d039-ac65 re-dispatch site, the orchestrator's next dispatch targets dso:verification-remediation-planner BEFORE any remediation ticket creation
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- The orchestrator MUST NOT create any ticket (including draft, placeholder, or precursor tickets) between detecting P1 != PASS and receiving planner output. Fixture: assert the ticket-CLI (`.claude/scripts/dso ticket create` and any equivalent) is not invoked between verifier-result read and planner-result read at all three sites
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When the planner returns confidence != LOW, the orchestrator dispatches the indicated decomposer with the planner's decomposer_context; when confidence == LOW, the orchestrator halts with HALT_FOR_USER surfacing the planner's evidence
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Sprint end-to-end fixture passes: synthetic verifier outputs covering all four decision-tree branches each route through the planner and produce the correct downstream dispatch or HALT
  ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Safety] The 'before any remediation ticket is written' invariant is load-bearing — adding even a placeholder ticket between verifier and planner violates SC3. Order matters.
- [Composition] HALT_FOR_USER (this story) vs REPLAN_ESCALATE (SC4 touchpoint-embedding story) must remain structurally exclusive per the shared protocol invariant.
- [Discoverability] sc-3 references a third planner-dispatch site at 'd039-ac65 re-dispatch'. Implementers must locate this site in existing sprint orchestration code BEFORE implementing — if the site no longer exists or has been refactored, this story must update sc-3 via amendment ticket rather than silently dropping the third dispatch site. The fixture must cover all three sites independently, not assume site 3 reuses site 1 plumbing.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
